meta.title: 晋升答辩：细节、高度、复盘与未来
meta.title_en: Promotion Defense: Details, Perspective, Review, and Future

scenes.context: 评委的四个标准：细节、高度、复盘、数据。讲者用房子类比解释「高度」：既能在事情内部看清细节，也能抽身事外俯视全局——从高处能看到花园、隔壁房间、周围的楼。房子好不好不只由房间本身决定，还有环境、安保、空气和停车位，所以判断工作也要站在更高维度，看到上下游、行业竞品与公司战略。
sentences: 你有细节、有高度、有复盘、有数据。
You've got the details, the big picture, the review, and the data.
有高度：the big picture；有复盘：the review
我既能在事情里面看，也能抽身到事情之上来看。
I can look at the work from the inside, and I can also step back and look at it from above.
抽身到事情之上：step back and look from above
从高处俯视，能看到花园、旁边的房间、旁边的楼——这叫高度。
Looking down from above, you can see the garden, the rooms next door, and the buildings around — that's perspective.
俯视：look down from above
paraphrase: 「高度」= 既钻得进细节，也抽得身来看全局
'Perspective' means diving into details and also stepping back to see the whole picture.
房子好坏不由单间决定 → 工作好坏要放在更高维度看
A house isn't judged by one room alone — work should be judged from a higher dimension.
scenes.speak: You've got the details, the big picture, the review, and the data. I can look at the work from the inside, and I can also step back and look at it from above. Looking down from above, you can see the garden, the rooms next door, and the buildings around — that's what perspective really means.

scenes.title_cn: 复盘：住进去才知道的隐性风险
scenes.title_en: Review: hidden risks only discovered by living in
scenes.context: 讲者把「复盘」比作住进装修好的房子：只有住上一段时间，才会发现天花板半夜滴水这类隐性问题。复盘和总结让「没住过就不知道」的风险变成经验，评委因此认可你「有复盘」。
sentences: 就像房子装修完，要住上一段时间，才会发现一些隐性问题。
Just like a house after renovation, you have to live in it for a while before the hidden problems surface.
隐性问题：hidden problems that surface
这个就是复盘和总结嘛。
That's what review and reflection are all about.
复盘总结：review and reflection
比如这种房子，天花板里有滴水声，半夜两点才会有，没住过的人根本不知道。
Take this kind of house: there's a dripping sound in the ceiling, but it only appears at two in the morning — you'd never know unless you'd lived there.
滴水声：a dripping sound；没住过不知道：never know unless you live there
paraphrase: 装修完 ≠ 万事大吉，住过才知隐患 → 复盘不可或缺
Finishing renovation isn't the end — only living there reveals issues, so review is a must.
复盘的产出是「没住过就不知道」的经验
Review turns risks you can't see until you live with them into known experience.
scenes.speak: Just like a house after renovation, you have to live in it for a while before the hidden problems surface. That's what review and reflection are all about. Take this kind of house: there's a dripping sound in the ceiling, but it only appears at two in the morning — you'd never know unless you'd lived there.

scenes.title_cn: 未来构想：经验可复制才能晋升
scenes.title_en: Future vision: replicable experience wins promotion
scenes.context: 晋升问题实质是：经验和做法可复制吗？对事情的把控能否外延扩大？两条晋升路径：把经验抽象成方法论去带人，或把 2 万一平的房子做到 10 万估值。评委考察三点：细节是否真做、认知维度深度、未来构想，外加表达的气场与自信。
sentences: 晋升问题的本质是：你的经验和做法可复制吗？
The essence of a promotion question is: is your experience and your way of working replicable?
可复制：replicable
把经验抽象成方法论，我就能带人、指导所有人，所以我就晋升上去了。
Once I abstract that experience into a methodology, I can mentor people and coach everyone — and that's how I earn the promotion.
抽象成方法论：abstract into a methodology；带人：mentor people
评委考察的无非是：细节是不是你真做的，认知有多深，以及对未来的构想。
All the panel really weighs is whether the details are truly yours, how deep your understanding runs, and what your vision for the future is.
评委考察：what the panel weighs；未来构想：vision for the future
paraphrase: 晋升的本质 = 经验可复制 + 把控范围外延扩大
Promotion is really about replicable experience and an ever-expanding scope of ownership.
评委考察：细节真实性 → 认知深度 → 未来构想 → 气场自信
The panel weighs real details, depth of thinking, future vision, and confident presence.
scenes.speak: The essence of a promotion question is: is your experience and your way of working replicable? Once I abstract that experience into a methodology, I can mentor people and coach everyone — and that's how I earn the promotion. All the panel really weighs is whether the details are truly yours, how deep your understanding runs, and what your vision for the future is.

practice: 表达「评委看的四个维度」
The panel looks for details, big-picture perspective, review, and data.
You need to zoom out and see the whole picture from above.
表达「复盘才发现的隐性风险」
Hidden risks only surface after you've lived with the work.
To get promoted, your experience has to be replicable.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I have height and detail.
✓ 地道说法：I've got the details and the big picture.
「高度」是比喻，讲整体视角，用 the big picture，不是物理高度 height。
✕ 直译腔：Look at this from the top.
✓ 地道说法：Zoom out and look at it from above.
职场里「俯视全局」用 zoom out / step back 更自然。
✕ 直译腔：We need a summary after the project.
✓ 地道说法：We should review and reflect on what happened.
「复盘」对应 review / reflect；summary 只是「总结」，丢了复盘的反省含义。
✕ 直译腔：My method can be copied by others.
✓ 地道说法：My approach is replicable at scale.
「可复制」用 replicable 更准确；copy 带「照抄」意味。
shifts: 把晋升答辩当成「罗列做过的项目清单」
把晋升答辩当成「证明方法论可复制、未来可构想」
把「高度」当成玄乎的套话
把「高度」拆解成「事内看细节 + 事上俯视全局」
把复盘当作「项目收尾的形式总结」
把复盘当作「只有住进去才能发现的隐性经验积累」
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「有时超」按上下文校正为「有数据」）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
